prerequisites: Basic knowledge of programming and design.

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to independently realize generative design projects with reference to object-oriented programming concepts.
Students are able to integrate programming fundamentals and concepts into the practice of generative design and learn an intuitive handling through constant repetition of application.

Students are able to design and realize complex generative design using diverse, constantly changing technical tools. They possess a pronounced methodical competence to quickly acquire the use of these, whereby solid knowledge of programming concepts is of prominent importance.
Students have acquired pronounced skills in defining and implementing application fields of generative design.
Students can conceptualize innovative generative design methods and procedures that are suitable for addressing and solving selected design problems in a target group-oriented manner.
Students are able to present ideas, concepts and work results in writing and images, as well as rhetorically differentiated and target-group-appropriate.
Students are able to live up to the responsibility of the designer through constant evaluation of individual design actions.

syllabus_topics: Theoretical foundations of object-oriented programming, methods and strategies of generative design
Practical deepening in the context of individual, free, generative design tasks
Introduction to appropriate development environments, their application, and their typical application spectrum
teaching_methods: Reception of other media or sources
assessment_rules: The un-graded assessment in the module is understood as the basis for the graded assessment. The result of the experimental work will be described in the project report and presented.
